text:
sam: Heads up — a recent eu-west canary failed, model-server pods stuck Pending. Looks like PVC storageClassName got dropped when values.pvc.storage is an empty map.
maya: Ugh. We saw this before with the notebook chart. Empty map + our helpers can lead to omitted keys. Which template is affected?
sam: charts/model-server/templates/pvc.yaml. We have `storageClassName: {{ .Values.pvc.storage.storageClass | default .Values.global.storageClass }}`. When deploying with `pvc: { storage: {} }` the rendered manifest is missing the entire `storageClassName:` line.
chris: FYI helm/sprig `default` only triggers on missing/<no value>/empty string. If the helper does a `coalesce` or returns the empty map, `toYaml` may render nothing. Could be our helper returns the parent map and then the nested key lookup becomes `<no value>` but helper logic then suppresses the line.
maya: I dug into the helper: `helpers/_pvc.tpl` uses `coalesce` and then `toYaml` plus `nindent`. `coalesce` treats empty map as non-empty sometimes which makes conditions false and we end up not emitting the key.
nina: Repro steps I used: `helm template --values ci/empty-pvc.yaml .` where ci/empty-pvc.yaml contains `pvc: { storage: {} }`. Output showed PVC without `storageClassName` — scheduler picked default (cpu) and pods waited for gpu nodes.
chris: Proposed fixes: 1) change helper to explicitly look up the scalar `storageClass` and guard with `if ne $sc ""` before rendering the `storageClassName` key; 2) update values.schema.json to reject empty objects at `pvc.storage` (type: object + minProperties: 1) so CI fails earlier; 3) add a helm-unittest case to catch empty-map rendering.  
maya: +1 to schema validation + helper guard. Schema prevents accidental overlay patterns where people write `{}` to mean "unset".
infra-bot: :robot_face: Created INF-5421 to track: (a) helper change; (b) values.schema update; (c) helm-unittest + chart-testing pipeline gate.
sam: I'll open the PR with the helper change and schema tweak. Plan: small template change first (safe, minimal), then add helm unittest and chart-testing job. I'll tag you, @maya, for review.
nina: Can we also add a short note to the GitOps docs explaining how empty map overlays are interpreted? We've had a few incidents where overlays with `{}` silently remove keys.
chris: Also recommend adding a rollout-canary check in the automated pipeline: verify that expected nodeSelector / storageClassName exists in the rendered pod spec for gpu workloads. Quick grep around that step would catch regressions before traffic.
maya: Sounds good. Sam assign me as reviewer and add the unittest. I'll also add a lint rule to the chart-lint job to fail on `pvc.storage: {}` in examples. :thumbsup:
sam: Thanks all — PR inbound in the next hour.
